src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Which Indian body certifies organic products?
x: Organic certification in India runs under the National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) of the Ministry of Commerce, with APEDA as its secretariat (it accredits the certification agencies), so APEDA is the expected answer. FSSAI regulates the sale and labelling of food, BIS sets product standards and CSIR is a research body – none of them runs organic certification.

s:
Select the option that shows the correct chronological order of the following events in India's economy.

A. India's first union budget was presented in Parliament.

B. Indira Gandhi nationalised 14 private banks.

C. Indira Gandhi took the drastic step of devaluing the Indian rupee by a sharp 57%.

D. This budget lowered direct taxes for companies and raised exemption limits for income tax.

E. The dismantling of the licence Raj by the Narasimha Rao-led government.
x:
Printed key: A, C, B, D, E (D read as V.P. Singh's 1985-86 Budget). If D is taken as the 1997-98 'Dream Budget' (corporate and income-tax cuts), the strict order would be A, C, B, E, D, which is not offered.
First Union Budget of independent India (26 Nov 1947, R.K. Shanmukham Chetty) → rupee devalued by about 57% (June 1966) → 14 banks nationalised (19 July 1969) → direct-tax-cutting Budget (read as V.P. Singh's 1985-86 Budget) → Licence Raj dismantled (1991). Options starting A, E or B, C put 1991 or 1969 out of order; only A, C, B, D, E keeps devaluation before nationalisation.

s: Demonetization was implemented in which year?
x: Demonetisation of the old ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes was announced by PM Narendra Modi on 8 November 2016 and took effect from that midnight, to curb black money and counterfeit notes and push digital payments. 2014-15 precede it; 2017 was the GST rollout year.

s: Out of the following, currency note of which new denomination is recently released by RBI?
x: RBI issued the new ₹200 denomination (Mahatma Gandhi New Series, bright yellow, Sanchi Stupa motif) on 25 August 2017. There are no ₹150, ₹250 or ₹300 notes.

s:
In connection with the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF), which of the following statement / statements is / are valid?
I. The fund will be established through reserved bonds taken from the G-Sec market.
II. The fund is to be exclusively availed by private agencies to create urban infrastructure in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
III. Eligible activities for UIDF shall be connected to the Missions and Programmes of the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MOHUA).
IV. The fund will be collectively managed by a cluster of Municipal Cooperative Banks. 82.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Only III is valid: UIDF's eligible activities are aligned to the missions and programmes of MoHUA. It is funded from banks' Priority Sector Lending shortfall (not G-Sec bonds, so I is wrong), used by public/State agencies and ULBs (not private agencies, so II is wrong) and managed by the National Housing Bank (not municipal cooperative banks, so IV is wrong).

src: APPSC Deputy Inspector of Survey, Technical Assistant in AP
s: Which Indian company announced the launch of an e-commerce app 'OrderMe' in May 2020?
x: Patanjali Ayurved (Baba Ramdev) launched 'OrderMe', a swadeshi-only e-commerce platform, on a pilot basis on 15 May 2020, after the 'vocal for local' call. ITC, Reliance (JioMart) and Tata were not behind OrderMe.
